original_equivalent_SQL:
SELECT c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,c.reasonForChange AS reason,c.summaryOfChange AS summary
FROM CR c WHERE c.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rel_REFERENCES r JOIN Agreement a ON a.node_id=r.src_id WHERE r.dst_id=c.node_id)
ORDER BY c.tdocNumber ASC
